title: A Suitable Boy

vibeProfile.oneLine: A mother's search for her daughter's husband opens up all of 1950s India.

summary: In newly independent India, a mother sets out to find a suitable husband for her daughter Lata, and around that simple quest Vikram Seth builds one of the longest novels in English, a vast, warm panorama of four families, politics, religion and a changing nation. Unhurried and hugely readable, it immerses you completely in 1950s India, from village to parliament. Comic, tender and richly peopled, it is a modern classic that readers disappear into for weeks and remember for years.
whyReadIt: A vast, warm, immersive panorama of 1950s India built around one marriage search. A modern classic to disappear into.

funFacts.text: At around 1,350 pages, it is one of the longest single-volume novels in the English language.
